note: Primitive tent/small-RV sites near the west shore of Hungry Horse Reservoir, Flathead NF (Hungry Horse-Glacier View RD), ~3,600 ft. About 24 mi SE of Hungry Horse on gravel West Side Rd/FR 895. Trout and whitefish fishing; boats launch at the Lost Johnny Point ramp. --Claude
summary: FS page (updated April 4, 2025) confirms 5 sites, vault toilet, no potable water, pack-in/pack-out. Not stated: fee, season, reservations/FCFS (derived FCFS left), trailer length (derived 22 ft left, see flag). No Flathead NF alert or closure for the campground or FR 895. Note trimmed of restated facilities, site count, FCFS and length.
